description: A bot told to fly to Dens only flies to an Angel Den and never to the Angel Hidden Den beside it (issue 182). The pilot undocks and leaves the station's grid; an Angel Hidden Den and an Angel Den are placed in space, the Hidden Den first; a bot of one 'fly to a pirate den, only Den' step is pasted into the Bot Builder and run in the page. The block reads each site's name from the scanner, so this fails if the names never arrive (the bot stops, saying no site could be named), if the list is ignored, or if Den matches inside Hidden Den.

setup.note: the held session: never a pilot the web client flies
drone recovery checks a pilot that has just signed in
